Title: A Small Invented Tale
Author: Jane Placeholder

*** START OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK A SMALL INVENTED TALE ***

CHAPTER I

The morning was bright and the river ran slow. A traveller walked along
the bank, humming a tune. She carried a small lantern, though the sun
was high.

Birds called from the far trees. The traveller stopped to rest beneath
an old oak and considered the road ahead.

CHAPTER II

By evening the sky had turned a deep orange. The traveller reached a
quiet village where lamps were being lit one by one.

An innkeeper greeted her warmly. He offered bread and a warm bed, and
asked where she was bound. She smiled but did not answer.

*** END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK A SMALL INVENTED TALE ***
